name: Le Havre

categories.label: Buildings and ships (printed value)
categories.labelVi: Công trình và tàu (giá trị in trên thẻ)
categories.hint: Number to the left of each card name, for every building and ship you own.

categories.label: Additional value of plus-symbol buildings
categories.labelVi: Giá trị cộng thêm của công trình có dấu +
categories.hint: E.g. Bank, Storehouse and other buildings with a + value that depends on your other cards; see card text.

categories.label: Cash (Francs)
categories.hint: Francs in hand. Goods in supply are worth nothing (except via Storehouse).

categories.label: Unpaid loans
categories.hint: Deduct 7 Francs per Loan card not repaid.

tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker: tied players are all winners.

notes: family: wealth-tally. Winner is the richest player after the final action. Some + values come from building text (Bank: +3 per industrial building and per economic building; Storehouse: half a Franc per goods token, rounded down). Shortened game and solo variants use the same wealth count.
